functions.purpose: Client UI marshaller that builds a PROPERTY_VO_CLASSNAME view-object describing the local player's combat stats plus the element/status flags of both weapon slots and the active armor/equipment skill list. Reads the player object (param_5, a CPlayer-like whose vtbl+0xb8 fills a scratch buffer) and pushes ~30 named fields into an AS3 data object. Guarded by param_6>1.
formulas: Player-context resolve: piVar4 = FUN_107cb5c0() (local CPlayer); requires piVar4 && local_130[0][0xc] && local_130[0][0xd] non-null before building.
Weapon slot pointers: main weapon = *(int*)(playerRec+0x30), sub weapon = *(int*)(playerRec+0x34); pcVar2 is the player record from FUN_108df100 chain.

Weapon element/status bitmask lives at *(uint*)(weaponSlot+0x78). Per-bit booleans emitted (FUN_104d15e0): bit0,bit1,bit2 (fire/water/thunder tolerances group per string order), bit3 = weaponAttackContainsDragon, bit4 = weaponAttackContainsIce, bit6 = weaponAttackContainsPoison, bit7 = weaponAttackContainsSleep, bit8 = (11dd64fc string) e.g. paralysis. Same 9-bit decode done for both main(0x30) and sub(0x34) slots.
Attribute type detection: ((uint)param_5[7] & 0x8f) == 3 or == 4 selects weapon-attack container pointer param_5[8], else sentinel 0xdeadbeaf.

Armor/equipment skill iteration (two lists at playerRec+0x48 loop): base = *(int*)(rec+0x48), count = (*(rec+0x4c) - base)/0x14 (stride 0x14=20 bytes). Per non-null entry emits skillName=*(entry+0x18), needPoint=*(entry+0x24), skillEffect=(entry+0x1c), bIsActivation=1, bCanBeLighten=*(byte)(entry+8). Same pattern repeated for a second list (activated vs available skills).

A third skill list built under piStack_84[0x9838] non-zero: 10-iteration table (iVar5=10) stepping puVar6 += 0x12 words per row, emitting a 'collumn' grid; used when player has some feature flag at CPlayer+0x9838*4.
Emits floats via FUN_104d14d0 (setFloat, e.g. luckattack) and CPlayer::GetHuntRankOrCount() for hunt-rank/hrLevel fields.
curendure/endure flag: ((byte)uStack_d4 & 0x8f) == 10 (AS3 string-type discriminant).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only VO builder; but the field schema is authoritative-relevant: it enumerates the player property model (curhp, endure, curendure, level, netID, hrLevel, hrPoint, Attack, lucklevel, luckattack, water/thunder/dragon attack, defense, water/fire/thunder/dragon/ice tolerance) and the per-weapon element+status bitmask layout (weapon+0x78 bits: Dragon=3,Ice=4,Poison=6,Sleep=7). Equipment/armor skill entries (skillName@+0x18, needPoint@+0x24, skillEffect@+0x1c, canBeLighten@+8, stride 0x14) are the server-owned skill definitions the client displays.
functions.notes: Very large auto-decompiled; stack-pointer aliasing obscures exact field order. weaponAttackContains* string args (Dragon/Ice/Poison/Sleep) are literal in code; earlier bit labels come from DAT_ pointers (11dd6358/6374/6390 etc.) not resolved to text here.

functions.purpose: Client UI builder for the farm/garden panel: builds a CP_VO_CLASSNAME list of 'collect pets' (0x98 entries) and a PLANT_VO_CLASSNAME list of 3 plant plots, computing collectability and remaining time from server timestamps. Uses _time64 for now.
formulas: Collect-pet loop: iterates iVar3 = 0..0x97 (0x98=152 slots); per-slot record pointer piVar9 advances +5 ints (0x14 bytes). level = (short)*piVar9.
maxLevel = *(int*)(FUN_117c7e70() + petTypeOffset).

canCollect logic: _Var11 = _time64(0); now = (int)_Var11. If ( *(short*)((int)piVar9+2)==0 && piVar9[1]!=0 && ((uint)(now - piVar9[1]))/0x3c < *(uint*)(cfg+0x1c) ) then canCollect=0 else 1. (0x3c=60, converts seconds to minutes; cfg+0x1c = required minutes.)
totalTime = (piVar9[1] + *(int*)(cfg+0x1c) * 0x3c) - now   (start-timestamp + requiredMinutes*60 - now = seconds remaining).
If cfg (FUN_108e1450 result) is null: canCollect emitted with no value (default) and totalTime=0.

Plant loop: 3 plots (iVar3<3), record piVar7 advances +3 ints. seedID via FUN_10254130; state=*(piVar7+2). totalTime = FUN_114219c0(0,iVar3) (server remaining time). canCollect = (iVar6!=0 && iVar8<=0) ? 1 : 0 where iVar8 = totalTime.
petSkillList emitted as nested list per collect-pet (FUN_11a98a70 array + setter vtbl+0x14).
costs: cfg+0x1c = required grow/produce minutes per collect-pet type (time gate, not currency).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only display; server is authoritative for the collect timestamps (piVar9[1] start time), required-minutes config (cfg+0x1c), and plant remaining time (FUN_114219c0). Server must validate canCollect (elapsed>=required) before granting the collect reward. Confirms fields: level, maxLevel, canCollect, totalTime(seconds), seedID, state, itemIconPathName.

functions.purpose: Builds one profound-skill tip VO from a talent record (param_2), reading fixed offsets, and resolves a TipsDesc string from a 2D tips table indexed by the skill index.
formulas: SkillID=*(rec+4), WeaponType=*(rec+0x10), PlayerLevel=*(rec+0x14), HunterRank=*(rec+0x18), SkillIndex=*(rec+0x20), Card1ID=*(rec+0x24), Card2ID=*(rec+0x28), Card3ID=*(rec+0x2c), Status=*(rec+0x48).

TipsDesc lookup: idx = *(rec+0xc); tbl = FUN_107d45b0(); valid if idx!=-1 && (idx!=0 || *(tbl+0x30)==0) && *(tbl+0x28)!=0 && (idx -= *(tbl+0x30)) in [0, *(tbl+0x24)). Then row = *(*(tbl+0x20) + (idx / *(tbl+0x28))*4); cell = *(row + (idx % *(tbl+0x28))*4); if cell!=0 emit TipsDesc. (Standard MHO chunked-2D table: base+0x20 rows, +0x28 stride, +0x24 count, +0x30 offset.)
functions.serverRelevance: client-only display; confirms profound-skill record layout (offsets above) and card-slot association (Card1/2/3 ID). Server owns Status (activated/locked) and card requirements.
